source_row.rationale: Research generally supports that higher staff satisfaction is associated with improved nurse retention, along with connections to patient care quality and safety outcomes, supporting organizational investment in factors contributing to a positive work environment (such as adequate staffing, supportive leadership, professional development opportunities, and a healthy workplace culture), not just compensation alone.
